# <test> <seconds>: ./dirac/oracle top-level tests of >= 1 s, for scripts/ci-oracle-shard.sh's deal.
# A test's seconds are the sum of its leaf (sub)tests' run times: its cost, not its wall, so a test that
# plays its seeds as parallel subtests weighs what it plays. Measured: land 905c8efadf on the gate box
# (-parallel 16, GOMAXPROCS=16, loaded box: the scale is relative), before the seed chunks, which play
# the same games: chunks inside an isolated child overlap the parent's tests, so their run times there
# overstate their cost (up to 7x). Unlisted tests weigh DEFAULT_SECONDS (0.08, the median of the
# rest). Refresh from a whole-package -v log, or the "slowest tests" lines the CI parts print.
